answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can earn: a new sparrow-like identity with no track record gets only tiny tasks, while reputation grows slowly across many epochs. Crossing the tundra of cheap identity creation, an attacker would need to fund and age thousands of separate stakes, like forging ferrous credentials one by one, so faking scale costs real capital and time instead of just spinning up free accounts.
